title: Reproducibility package for: A double inertial S-iteration algorithm with Tikhonov regularization for common fixed points and forward-backward splitting, with applications to medical image deblurring and medical data classification
description:
Code and data that reproduce every table and figure and every number quoted in Section 4 of the paper by S. Suantai and K. Janngam, submitted to the Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics. The package contains Algorithm 1 (TISPSA), the Tikhonov-regularized Krasnosel'skii–Mann algorithm of Boţ and Meier (2021), the experiments of Sections 4.1–4.5 (split feasibility problems, medical image deblurring, medical data classification, ablation study, variable step sizes), the data, and the exact outputs used in the paper. Running python run_all.py results and then python verify.py results expected_results checks that the new results agree with the paper.

The code is released under the MIT license. The data files keep the licenses of their sources (CC0 for the fundus image, MIT for the MRI dataset, CC BY-NC 4.0 / CC BY-NC-SA for the CT image, CC BY 4.0 and public domain for the clinical datasets); see data/SOURCES.md.
